KXNHLDRAFTPICK.note: No markets/rules sampled. 'Pro Hockey' follows Kalshi's naming for the NHL (cf. 'Pro Football'). A draft slot is decided by the lottery, who owns which pick and each club's choice from a prospect board. Neither awards voting nor game events produce that, so unreg:draft_selection is justified even with only 2 members. NO_LISTING with low confidence is the honest call.

KXNHLDRAFTTOP.note: Same draft mechanism as KXNHLDRAFTPICK: lottery winner plus the consensus-board top prospect. No rules text, so NO_LISTING/low is correct. Whether YES names the player or the team picking is unverified. The season_award blueprint fits: a few decision-makers pick from a ranked candidate list.

KXNHLMVP.note: No markets or rules. The title 'NHL Hart Memorial Trophy Winner' matches KXNHLHART, whose rules text confirms a Hart award contract. Awards voting is the mechanism, so season_awards_and_stats is right and game_moneyline_puckline (ledger) was clearly wrong. Low confidence is appropriate for an unseen duplicate.

KXNHLRICHARD.note: Rules: YES if the named player wins the Rocket Richard Award; ties pay $1/N. The award goes automatically to the regular-season goals leader, no voting. That is exactly the 'leaders for season player stats' part of season_awards_and_stats's target, so no new archetype is needed and season_futures (ledger) was wrong.

KXNHLROSS.note: Rules: YES if the named player wins the Art Ross Trophy; ties pay $1/N per the contract (the NHL's own tie-breakers are irrelevant to settlement). This is a points-leader race across all skaters, which season_awards_and_stats's stat-leader target covers. It is a different question from threshold totals (KXNHLSEASONPPTS).

KXNHLSERIES.note: No markets or rules. The title says best-of-7 playoff series winner, and season_futures's target explicitly includes 'wins a playoff series'. The per-game win probability, home-ice pattern and goalie volatility are inputs to that archetype, not a separate mechanism, so a new archetype would duplicate an existing process. NO_LISTING/low is fine.

KXNHLSERIESTOTALGOAL.note: season_futures generates which team wins a series, not how many goals are scored across it. The outcome is goals summed over a random 4-7 games, and series length depends on how evenly matched the teams are. The ledger also has Series Total Games, Spread, Exact Score, OT and a duplicate Total Goals ticker built on the same series-length machinery. Moved to a new playoff_series_aggregate archetype.

KXNHLWSTREAK.note: The longest win streak is a league-wide maximum over 32 teams of a path statistic from simulating each team's season game by game. It is not a season total against a threshold (the counting archetype's target). It has the same structure as President's Trophy (season_futures): which team leads a league-wide season measure, with ties split. Moved to season_futures; a one-series new archetype is not warranted.

KXNHLSERIESTOTALGOAL.reason: Title 'NHL Series Total Goals', no markets or rules. The outcome is total goals summed over a random-length 4-7 game playoff series. Series length depends on how evenly matched the teams are (close matchups mean more games and more goals). Neither the single-game total archetype nor season_futures (who wins the series) produces this variable. The strike, OT inclusion and source of truth are unverified.

KXNHLWSTREAK.quote: If Washington Capitals has the longest winning streak in the NHL 2026-27 regular season, then the market resolves to Yes.
KXNHLWSTREAK.reason: YES if the team has the league's longest regular-season win streak; tied teams split $1/N. This is a league-wide maximum over 32 teams, produced by the same game-by-game season simulation (team strength, schedule, back-to-backs, goalie rotation) behind the President's Trophy and division futures, and it is read off the path of results. It is not a total compared with a threshold, so the counting archetype does not fit. OT and shootout wins presumably count as wins, but the rules do not say.

playoff_series_aggregate.label: NHL playoff series aggregate outcomes (series total goals and related series-length props)
playoff_series_aggregate.target: A quantity added up across one best-of-7 playoff series (e.g. total goals in all games) compared with a threshold. Its value depends jointly on the number of games played (4-7) and on scoring in each game.
playoff_series_aggregate.why_distinct: The outcome is a sum over a random number of games, and that number depends on the two teams' per-game win probabilities and the home-ice sequence. The single-game total archetype models one game of fixed length. season_futures models only who wins the series. Ledger siblings on the same mechanism (Series Total Games, Series Game Spread, Series Exact Score, Series Overtime, KXNHLSERIESTOTALGOALS) have no listed markets and are not in this pack.
